home.hero_label: Est. in the Heart of Odessa
home.hero_description: Where Italian precision meets the architectural soul of Ukraine. We craft more than furniture; we forge the heritage of your home.
home.philosophy_quote: We do not believe in the temporary. Every piece that leaves our workshop is built to witness a century of family gatherings.
home.philosophy_body: Rooted in the rich artisan traditions of Odessa and inspired by Italian furniture design, our atelier specialises in hand-crafted joinery that defies mass-market standards. We source only sustainable hardwoods, treated with natural oils to preserve the living soul of the material.
home.cta_body: Contact our head atelier for a private consultation. We specialise in full-home interior solutions and unique standalone statements.

about.title: The Master
about.subtitle: Igor Vasylkov — Bespoke Furniture Atelier, Est. 2002
about.body:
After Ukrainian independence, Igor Vasylkov, a former military officer, spent much of the 1990s working two jobs at once. At some point that stopped feeling like a plan. He wanted work that was genuinely his. Something worth giving his time to.

He started by building the kitchen in his new apartment. Designed it himself, built it himself. It worked. He kept going. In 2002, he opened a workshop in Odessa. The rule was simple: take work worth doing, and do it with care.

Twenty-plus years on, the approach hasn't changed. Homeowners, restaurant owners, developers across Ukraine and further out. They come when they want something made, not selected.
about.craft_text:
We don't avoid complicated projects. Full apartment interiors, restaurants, spaces with unusual layouts or existing structures that need matching — that's most of what we do.

We're involved from the first conversation through to installation, working directly with clients. When architects or designers are involved, we work alongside them. The question we keep coming back to: will this still look good and feel right in ten years? In twenty?

Materials aren't a constraint here. Oak, walnut, metal, glass — old buildings with unusual finishes that need to be matched exactly. Clients tend to be surprised that the piece feels handmade and also fits with precision. That combination takes effort. We think it's the point.

Furniture that gets passed down.
